title: c62 leaves
summary: c62 leaves. Reviews: c60's half-taxis ecology and c56's prey claim (both Weak: replicate and pass the L4c consumption-off arms, but D is a prey-predator pair co-fission), and c52's ecology (E fails the consumption-off gate at chiF 0.5). Negative: growing predators, prey turnover, CIPS-cell hybrid, predator fusion screen. New line: a Flow-Lenia digestion ecology with free predators of conserved matter (claims 20261028T0303-c62-flow-lenia-ecology-claim and 20261028T0344-c62-flow-lenia-ecology-s-claim, SIXDE from noise; robustness and supply-threshold findings).
